name: Mr. Cloak
detailed_description:
• Mr. Cloak is setting out to be the first adventurer to explore the massive labyrinth under the city of Dravaneth...    and live to tell the tale!

  • Use stealth to work your way through the heavily guarded sections of the labyrinth to locate keys and find an escape

  • Every level has multiple exits that will unlock unique pathways to new levels and areas, leaving it up to you to map your own escape route through the labyrinth. There are six different regions to explore, all with their own unique threats and challenges

  • Be the first to discover the secrets of the labyrinth and escape with your own life!

short_description: Be the first to explore the uncharted labyrinth beneath the city of Dravaneth as Mr. Cloak. Use stealth and wit to uncover its secrets, evade deadly traps, and chart your own escape route. Every level has multiple exits, unlocking new paths, areas, and dangers in your journey to survive.

  • Processor: Dual-core Intel or AMD (2.0 GHz)
